memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, works night shifts as nurse, reports mild fatigue after long walks.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal), no complaints of forgetfulness.
falls: No falls in past 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 6 regular – silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD, salbutamol MDI SOS, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD, montelukast 10 mg HS, propranolol 40 mg OD. Polypharmacy noted, review against Beers criteria planned.
mood: Reports occasional stress, denies depression or anxiety, PHQ-2 negative.
carers: Lives alone, mother (Mrs Lakshmi Kulkarni) provides occasional support.
goals: "I want to stay healthy enough to continue my nursing job and keep my migraines under control."

memories.text: Spirometry with reversibility: Pre-bronchodilator FEV1 2.8 L (78% predicted), FVC 3.6 L (85%), FEV1/FVC 0.78. Post-bronchodilator FEV1 3.1 L (86%), increase 10% and 200 mL – positive reversibility. Consistent with asthma.
